# Any scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES id 41 "ydg") while
# OR = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_on NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_init } }.
# No monthly on_action hook of its own.
oe_ydg_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_init } } oe_ydg_setup = yes }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_m value = oe_ydg_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_on }
        oe_ydg_end_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_on }
            oe_ydg_guard_sync = yes
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_opened } }
                if = { limit = { oe_ydg_can_open = yes } oe_ydg_do_open = yes }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_ydg_active = yes }
                oe_ydg_power_step = yes
                oe_ydg_ev_step = yes
            }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
}
# Any scope. First run in a game: before 1370.1.1, Mongol Yuan under Toghon Temür starts passive M7 guard tracking;
# M1 Eastern Palace opens from 1353.6.1 when the Crown Prince is alive. Otherwise stays off (code 8).
oe_ydg_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_ydg_init
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1370.1.1 oe_ydg_yuan_ok = yes oe_ydg_togon_rules = yes }
        set_global_variable = oe_ydg_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_power value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_guard value = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_guard_lock value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_c1 value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_c2 value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_c3 value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_c4 value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_c4_ok value = -1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_resent value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_wait value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_last value = 0 }
        oe_ydg_guard_sync = yes
        debug_log = "oe_ydg: the line runs (guard tracking active; donggong opens from 1353.6.1)"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_end value = 8 }
        debug_log = "oe_ydg: too late or no Mongol Yuan under Toghon Temur: line stays off (code 8)"
    }
}
# Any scope (F6 COLLAPSE_HOOKS interface, also monthly check). Yuan fell: line closes with code 2.
oe_ydg_on_yuan_fall = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_on } oe_ydg_finish = { code = 2 } }
}
# Any scope, monthly. End checks: 2 Yuan fell, 1 Crown Prince enthroned, 3 Toghon Temür gone & another rules, 4 reached 1370.1.1.
oe_ydg_end_check = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ydg_yuan_ok = no } oe_ydg_on_yuan_fall = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_ydg_cp_rules = yes } oe_ydg_finish = { code = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_ydg_togon_gone = yes } oe_ydg_finish = { code = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1370.1.1 } oe_ydg_finish = { code = 4 } }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_ydg_finish = { code = N }: removes this line's modifiers and closes the line.
oe_ydg_finish = {
    oe_ydg_strip = yes
    remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_on
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_end value = $code$ }
    debug_log = "oe_ydg: the line ends (code in oe_ydg_end)"
}
# Any scope. Removes all modifiers owned by this line from CHI.
oe_ydg_strip = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ydg_favorites } remove_country_modifier = oe_ydg_favorites } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ydg_two_palaces_rift } remove_country_modifier = oe_ydg_two_palaces_rift } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ydg_regency } remove_country_modifier = oe_ydg_regency } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ydg_chosgem } remove_country_modifier = oe_ydg_chosgem } } }
}
# Any scope. Debug counter: visible events sent by this line (global oe_dbg_n_ydg).

    change_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_ydg add = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Usage: oe_ydg_add_power = { amount = N }: changes Eastern Palace power (clamped 0-100) while opened.
oe_ydg_add_power = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_opened }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_power } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_power value = 25 } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_power add = $amount$ }
        clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_power min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
}

# ---- passive M7 guard sync & M1 power drift
# Any scope. Passive sync of M7 oe_ydg_guard with Bolod / Bayan / Toqto'a (from 1349.6) when not explicitly overridden.
oe_ydg_guard_sync = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_ydg_guard_lock ?= 1 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_ydg_bolod = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_guard value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ydg_bayan = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_guard value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ydg_toqto = yes current_date >= 1349.6.1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_guard value = 2 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_guard value = 1 } }
    }
}

# Any scope, monthly while M1 is active. Lapses missed events, runs AI W3 if eligible, else picks at most one visible event.
oe_ydg_ev_step = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ydg_lapse_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ydg_lapse_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ydg_lapse_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ydg_lapse_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ydg_w3_ready = yes }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ydg_m >= 320 } oe_ydg_w3 = yes }
        else = { random = { chance = 12 oe_ydg_w3 = yes } }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_wait } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_wait value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_ydg_busy = no global_var:oe_ydg_wait >= 2 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_ydg_due_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_pick value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ydg_due_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_pick value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ydg_due_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_pick value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ydg_due_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_pick value = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_ydg_pick ?= 0 oe_ydg_busy = no }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ydg_pick ?= 0 oe_ydg_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = 15 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ydg_pick ?= 0 oe_ydg_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = 15 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ydg_pick ?= 0 oe_ydg_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = 12 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ydg_pick ?= 0 oe_ydg_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = 20 set_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_pick value = 4 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ydg_pick ?= 0 oe_ydg_busy = yes oe_ydg_any_due = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_ydg_wait add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ydg_pick ?= 1 } oe_ydg_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ydg_pick ?= 2 } oe_ydg_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ydg_pick ?= 3 } oe_ydg_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_ydg_pick ?= 4 } oe_ydg_fire_4 = yes }
    remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_pick
}

    oe_ydg_set_guard = { who = $who$ }
    oe_ydg_log = yes
}
oe_ydg_test_fall = {
    oe_ydg_on_yuan_fall = yes
    oe_ydg_log = yes
}
oe_ydg_test_clear = {
    oe_ydg_strip = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_on } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_on }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_init } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_init }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_end } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_end }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_m } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_opened } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_opened }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_open_m } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_open_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_power } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_power }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_guard } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_guard }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_guard_lock } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_guard_lock }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_c1 } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_c1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_c2 } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_c2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_c3 } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_c3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_c4 } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_c4 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_c4_ok } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_c4_ok }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_resent } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_resent }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_wait } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_wait }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_pick } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_pick }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_last } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_last }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_y1n } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_y1n }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_t_ev } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_t_ev }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_ydg } remove_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_ydg }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_st_1 } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_st_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_st_2 } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_st_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_st_3 } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_st_3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ydg_st_4 } remove_global_variable = oe_ydg_st_4 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ydg_job } remove_variable = oe_ydg_job } } }
}
oe_ydg_test_clear_log = {
    oe_ydg_test_clear = yes
    debug_log = "oe_ydg TEST: cleared; the line starts again next month"
}
